title: Dreamcoder Machine Profile
description: Schema for Dreamcoder machine profiles — defines monitor, keyboard, shell, and keybinding configuration for Hyprland ML4W integration.

name.description: Unique machine profile name (e.g., asus-vivobook15, desktop-ryzen, default)

description.description: Human-readable description of this profile and its target machine

monitor.description: Hyprland monitor string (e.g., eDP-1,1920x1080@60,0x0,1 or auto)

keyboard_layout.description: Hyprland keyboard layout (e.g., latam, us, es)

shell.description: Default shell command for terminal emulators

terminal_default_mode.description: Default terminal color mode for this machine

motion_preset.description: Hyprland motion/animation preset (fluid = smooth animations, balanced = moderate, reduced = minimal)

performance_notes.description: Free-form notes about performance tuning or hardware-specific considerations

super_mod.description: Super key modifier (usually SUPER for the Windows/Command key)

key.description: Key identifier: uppercase letter (D), function key (F1-F12), or raw keycode (code:237)

mods.description: Modifier keys. Use empty array [] for bare keys (Fn keys, media keys, keycodes).

command.description: Shell command or script path to execute

description.description: Human-readable description shown in Lua comments and help output

bind_type.description: Press or release trigger. 'press' = hl.bind(), 'release' = hl.bind(..., { release = true })

mouse.description: When true, adds the `mouse = true` flag to hl.bind() and puts the button in the key string (hl.mouse_bind does not exist). Requires 'button'.

button.description: Mouse button: BTN_LEFT/BTN_RIGHT... or mouse:<code> (BTN_SIDE=275, BTN_EXTRA=276). Required when mouse=true.

submap_entry.description: When set, this binding enters the named submap on activation.

locked.description: Whether the binding requires the session to be unlocked

repeating.description: Whether the binding repeats on key hold

disable_workspace_consume.description: Prevents the workspace from being consumed when triggered
